errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is not linear; the numerical distance between tick marks is not constant (e.g., 1e7 to 2e7 vs 2e7 to 5e7).
The x-axis tick marks are not at regular intervals of 1e7; they are placed at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, etc.

errors.text_span: Starting at a value of approximately 99.1 at 1e7 TFLOPS, it decreases slightly to 98.8 at 2e7 TFLOPS, then increases and plateaus around 99.6 for the remainder of the x-axis range.
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Vanilla' model is completely incorrect. The purple line is constant at 100% across the entire x-axis range.
The 'SepLLM (n=64)' model (orange line) has '+' markers, not circle markers. The red line has circle markers.

errors.text_span: leveling off around 99.6 from 5e8 TFLOPS onwards
errors.evidence: The orange line for 'SepLLM (n=64)' does not level off at 99.6. It peaks above 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs and then fluctuates around 100%.
The blue line for 'SepLLM (n=128)' is at approximately 98% at 2e7 TFLOPS, not 99.2%.

errors.text_span: stabilizes around 99.6 for the higher TFLOPS values
errors.evidence: The blue line for 'SepLLM (n=128)' stabilizes at a much higher value, around 99.8%, not 99.6%.
The green line for 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' is at approximately 98.6% at 2e7 TFLOPS, not 99.4%.

errors.text_span: stabilizes near 99.6 for larger values of TFLOPS
errors.evidence: The green line for 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' does not stabilize at 99.6%; it continues to rise, peaks above 100% at 6e8 TFLOPs, and then stays close to 100%.
The 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' model (red line) has circle markers, not square markers.

errors.text_span: increases steadily to roughly 98.5 at 2e7 TFLOPS
errors.evidence: The red line for 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' is at approximately 95.2% at 2e7 TFLOPS, not 98.5%. This is a significant error.
